summary: Tested Social Media Campaign Acquisition Funnel feature. Fixed 3 bugs: (1) Backend funnel.py returning Flask-style tuples instead of FastAPI HTTPException, (2) Frontend GetStartedPage.js feature card navigation not advancing past last feature, (3) FunnelAnalyticsTab.js incorrect auth header nesting. All 14 backend tests pass. Full funnel flow works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Backend funnel.py was returning Flask-style tuples (dict, status_code) instead of using FastAPI HTTPException for error responses
FIXED: Frontend GetStartedPage.js handleFeatureDecision() was not advancing currentFeatureIdx past the last feature, preventing Continue button from appearing
FIXED: FunnelAnalyticsTab.js was using { headers: getAuthHeaders() } but getAuthHeaders() already returns { headers: {...} }, causing nested headers
seed_data_creation: Test funnel sessions created during backend tests (35 total sessions in DB)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Funnel feature is fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /api/funnel/start, POST /api/funnel/step, POST /api/funnel/complete, POST /api/funnel/convert, GET /api/admin/funnel/analytics. Frontend: /get-started is a 5-step funnel (interests, family, features, CTA, referral). Admin Funnel tab shows analytics. Login page has 'New here?' link. Logged-in users are redirected from /get-started to /dashboard.

frontend.step1_interests_selection: PASS - 6 bubbles, gold highlight on selection, Continue enables
frontend.step2_family_selection: PASS - All 3 options required for Continue
frontend.step3_feature_cards: PASS - Skip/Keep buttons work, Continue appears after all reviewed
frontend.step4_cta_screen: PASS - Social proof stats visible, Start Trial button works
frontend.step5_referral_screen: PASS - Email input, Skip option, +7 days bonus text
frontend.progress_bar_advances: PASS - Progress bar width increases with each step

bugs_fixed.issue: Flask-style tuple returns instead of FastAPI HTTPException
handleFeatureDecision() only advanced index if currentFeatureIdx < length-1, preventing Continue button from appearing
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to always increment: setCurrentFeatureIdx(i => i + 1)
